hints.title: Partition by Remainder
hints.text: Partition elements into three groups based on num % 3.

hints.title: Sort Remainder Groups
hints.text: Sort each bucket in descending order to easily access its largest elements.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Can be optimized to O(n) by tracking top 3 elements per bucket.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^3) triplets takes cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping into 3 remainder lists takes O(n) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects remainder group enumeration and greedy top-element selection.
